subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: Should command-secret resolution skip the gateway RPC for active exec-backed target SecretRefs and resolve them locally when local exec is allowed?
rationale: The code path appears correct for the reported log-flood bug, but the final choice changes auth/provider SecretRef routing and local exec timing, which is a maintainer-owned boundary decision.

options.title: Accept the guarded local skip
options.body: Refresh and land the current shape if maintainers agree that active exec-backed command targets should avoid a gateway RPC the gateway cannot satisfy.

options.title: Keep gateway-first semantics
options.body: Reject or pause this PR and tolerate the current `UNAVAILABLE` noise until a gateway-owned resolver contract is designed.

options.title: Require a runtime-side redesign
options.body: Supersede this PR with a gateway/runtime-command-secret change if maintainers want partial snapshot success instead of CLI preflight skipping.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded local skip
recommendation.body: Refresh and land the current shape if maintainers agree that active exec-backed command targets should avoid a gateway RPC the gateway cannot satisfy.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the remaining decision is acceptance of the auth/security-sensitive command-secret boundary.
